<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; overflow: hidden; }
  body { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: sans-serif; }
  canvas {
    background: #1b1e2b;
    max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    display: block;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 360,
      // 1 = normal brick, 2 = tough brick, 0 = empty
      layout: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111'
      ]
    },
    {
      speed: 450,
      layout: [
        '2222222222',
        '2111111112',
        '2120000212',
        '2121111212',
        '2120000212',
        '2111111112',
        '2222222222'
      ]
    }
  ];
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ef476f', '#f78c6b', '#ffd166', '#06d6a0', '#118ab2', '#8e7dff', '#ff7bd5'];

  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 600 };
  const ball = { r: 8, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
  let bricks = [];
  let state = 'start'; // start | playing | paused | levelComplete | gameOver | win
  let score = 0, lives = 3, level = 0;
  const keys = {};
  let mouseX = null;

  function buildLevel(n) {
    const layout = LEVELS[n].layout;
    const cols = layout[0].length;
    const gap = 6, side = 30, top = HUD_H + 30;
    const bw = (W - side * 2 - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
    const bh = 22;
    bricks = [];
    layout.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((c, col) => {
        const hp = +c;
        if (!hp) return;
        bricks.push({
          x: side + col * (bw + gap), y: top + r * (bh + gap),
          w: bw, h: bh, hp, maxHp: hp, color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length]
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.stuck = true;
    ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
    placeBallOnPaddle();
  }
  function placeBallOnPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }
  function launch() {
    if (!ball.stuck) return;
    const speed = LEVELS[level].speed;
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3); // radians from vertical
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.stuck = false;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3; level = 0;
    buildLevel(level);
    resetBall();
    state = 'playing';
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / click
  function action() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'start': case 'gameOver': case 'win':
        newGame(); break;
      case 'levelComplete':
        level++; buildLevel(level); resetBall(); state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'paused':
        state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'playing':
        launch(); break;
    }
  }
  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
  }

  // Input
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    keys[k.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k.toLowerCase() === 'a' || k.toLowerCase() === 'd') mouseX = null;
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') action();
    else if (k === 'p' || k === 'P' || k === 'Escape') togglePause();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused'; });

  // Circle vs rect collision; returns axis of reflection or null
  function hitRect(rx, ry, rw, rh) {
    const cx = Math.max(rx, Math.min(ball.x, rx + rw));
    const cy = Math.max(ry, Math.min(ball.y, ry + rh));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) return null;
    const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - rx, rx + rw - (ball.x - ball.r));
    const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - ry, ry + rh - (ball.y - ball.r));
    return overlapX < overlapY ? 'x' : 'y';
  }

  function update(dt) {
    // Paddle
    const left = keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a'];
    const right = keys['arrowright'] || keys['d'];
    if (left || right) {
      paddle.x += (right ? 1 : 0) * paddle.speed * dt - (left ? 1 : 0) * paddle.speed * dt;
    } else if (mouseX !== null) {
      paddle.x = mouseX - paddle.w / 2;
    }
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

    if (ball.stuck) { placeBallOnPaddle(); return; }

    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.vy > 0 && hitRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h)) {
      const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel)) * (Math.PI / 3);
      const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
      ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    }

    // Bricks (one hit per frame)
    for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      const b = bricks[i];
      const axis = hitRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      if (!axis) continue;
      if (axis === 'x') {
        ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + b.w / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
      } else {
        ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + b.h / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
      b.hp--;
      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        score += b.maxHp > 1 ? 20 : 10;
        bricks.splice(i, 1);
      }
      break;
    }

    if (bricks.length === 0) {
      state = level < LEVELS.length - 1 ? 'levelComplete' : 'win';
      resetBall();
      return;
    }

    // Lost ball
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { state = 'gameOver'; }
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0f17';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + '/' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef476f';
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)) + '♡'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - lives)), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.5 : 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      if (b.maxHp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Paddle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e6ff';
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();

    // Ball
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    if (state === 'playing' && ball.stuck) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('Press Space or Click to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    }

    const overlays = {
      start: ['BRICK BREAKER', 'Move: ← → / A D or Mouse   •   Launch: Space / Click   •   Pause: P / Esc', 'Press Space or Click to start'],
      paused: ['PAUSED', '', 'Press P, Space or Click to resume'],
      levelComplete: ['LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' COMPLETE!', 'Score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click for level ' + (level + 2)],
      gameOver: ['GAME OVER', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click to play again'],
      win: ['YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click to play again']
    };
    const o = overlays[state];
    if (o) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[0], W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '17px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[1], W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[2], W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    }
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    if (state === 'playing') update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBall();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    background: #1b1e2b;
    max-width: 100vw; max-height: 100vh;
    width: min(100vw, calc(100vh * 4 / 3));
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    display: block;
    cursor: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const HUD_H = 40;

  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 360,
      // 1 = normal brick, 2 = tough brick, 0 = empty
      layout: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111'
      ]
    },
    {
      speed: 450,
      layout: [
        '2222222222',
        '2111111112',
        '2120000212',
        '2121111212',
        '2120000212',
        '2111111112',
        '2222222222'
      ]
    }
  ];
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ef476f', '#f78c6b', '#ffd166', '#06d6a0', '#118ab2', '#8e7dff', '#ff7bd5'];

  const paddle = { w: 110, h: 14, x: W / 2 - 55, y: H - 40, speed: 600 };
  const ball = { r: 8, x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, stuck: true };
  let bricks = [];
  let state = 'start'; // start | playing | paused | levelComplete | gameOver | win
  let score = 0, lives = 3, level = 0;
  const keys = {};
  let mouseX = null;

  function buildLevel(n) {
    const layout = LEVELS[n].layout;
    const cols = layout[0].length;
    const gap = 6, side = 30, top = HUD_H + 30;
    const bw = (W - side * 2 - gap * (cols - 1)) / cols;
    const bh = 22;
    bricks = [];
    layout.forEach((row, r) => {
      [...row].forEach((c, col) => {
        const hp = +c;
        if (!hp) return;
        bricks.push({
          x: side + col * (bw + gap), y: top + r * (bh + gap),
          w: bw, h: bh, hp, maxHp: hp, color: ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length]
        });
      });
    });
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.stuck = true;
    ball.vx = ball.vy = 0;
    placeBallOnPaddle();
  }
  function placeBallOnPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }
  function launch() {
    if (!ball.stuck) return;
    const speed = LEVELS[level].speed;
    const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3); // radians from vertical
    ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.stuck = false;
  }

  function newGame() {
    score = 0; lives = 3; level = 0;
    buildLevel(level);
    resetBall();
    state = 'playing';
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / click
  function action() {
    switch (state) {
      case 'start': case 'gameOver': case 'win':
        newGame(); break;
      case 'levelComplete':
        level++; buildLevel(level); resetBall(); state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'paused':
        state = 'playing'; break;
      case 'playing':
        launch(); break;
    }
  }
  function togglePause() {
    if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused';
    else if (state === 'paused') state = 'playing';
  }

  // Input
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    const k = e.key;
    if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' ', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(k)) e.preventDefault();
    keys[k.toLowerCase()] = true;
    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' || k.toLowerCase() === 'a' || k.toLowerCase() === 'd') mouseX = null;
    if (e.repeat) return;
    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') action();
    else if (k === 'p' || k === 'P' || k === 'Escape') togglePause();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key.toLowerCase()] = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    mouseX = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { e.preventDefault(); action(); });
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { if (state === 'playing') state = 'paused'; });

  // Circle vs rect collision; returns axis of reflection or null
  function hitRect(rx, ry, rw, rh) {
    const cx = Math.max(rx, Math.min(ball.x, rx + rw));
    const cy = Math.max(ry, Math.min(ball.y, ry + rh));
    const dx = ball.x - cx, dy = ball.y - cy;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) return null;
    const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - rx, rx + rw - (ball.x - ball.r));
    const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - ry, ry + rh - (ball.y - ball.r));
    return overlapX < overlapY ? 'x' : 'y';
  }

  function update(dt) {
    // Paddle
    const left = keys['arrowleft'] || keys['a'];
    const right = keys['arrowright'] || keys['d'];
    if (left || right) {
      paddle.x += (right ? 1 : 0) * paddle.speed * dt - (left ? 1 : 0) * paddle.speed * dt;
    } else if (mouseX !== null) {
      paddle.x = mouseX - paddle.w / 2;
    }
    paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

    if (ball.stuck) { placeBallOnPaddle(); return; }

    ball.x += ball.vx * dt;
    ball.y += ball.vy * dt;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.vy > 0 && hitRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h)) {
      const rel = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2);
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, rel)) * (Math.PI / 3);
      const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy);
      ball.vx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.vy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    }

    // Bricks (one hit per frame)
    for (let i = 0; i < bricks.length; i++) {
      const b = bricks[i];
      const axis = hitRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
      if (!axis) continue;
      if (axis === 'x') {
        ball.vx = ball.x < b.x + b.w / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx);
      } else {
        ball.vy = ball.y < b.y + b.h / 2 ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy);
      }
      b.hp--;
      if (b.hp <= 0) {
        score += b.maxHp > 1 ? 20 : 10;
        bricks.splice(i, 1);
      }
      break;
    }

    if (bricks.length === 0) {
      state = level < LEVELS.length - 1 ? 'levelComplete' : 'win';
      resetBall();
      return;
    }

    // Lost ball
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { state = 'gameOver'; }
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // HUD
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d0f17';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 16, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('Level ' + (level + 1) + '/' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, HUD_H / 2);
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef476f';
    ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '♥'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)) + '♡'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - lives)), W - 16, HUD_H / 2);

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = b.hp < b.maxHp ? 0.5 : 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fill();
      if (b.maxHp > 1) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Paddle
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e0e6ff';
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fill();

    // Ball
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    if (state === 'playing' && ball.stuck) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)';
      ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText('Press Space or Click to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 60);
    }

    const overlays = {
      start: ['BRICK BREAKER', 'Move: ← → / A D or Mouse   •   Launch: Space / Click   •   Pause: P / Esc', 'Press Space or Click to start'],
      paused: ['PAUSED', '', 'Press P, Space or Click to resume'],
      levelComplete: ['LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' COMPLETE!', 'Score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click for level ' + (level + 2)],
      gameOver: ['GAME OVER', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click to play again'],
      win: ['YOU WIN!', 'Final score: ' + score, 'Press Space or Click to play again']
    };
    const o = overlays[state];
    if (o) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166';
      ctx.font = 'bold 48px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[0], W / 2, H / 2 - 40);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.font = '17px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[1], W / 2, H / 2 + 10);
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(o[2], W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
    }
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function loop(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    if (state === 'playing') update(dt);
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  buildLevel(0);
  resetBall();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I wrote the game to `index.html` in the current folder, but I haven't opened it in a browser, so it hasn't been played or checked for errors yet. To try it, open the file in any browser; it needs nothing else to run.

- **2 levels:**
  - **Level 1:** 5 rows of 10 bricks that each break in one hit.
  - **Level 2:** a denser pattern with tough bricks that take two hits (they have a white outline and fade after the first hit), and the ball moves faster.
- **Score:** 10 points per normal brick and 20 per tough brick. The score, current level and lives show along the top of the screen.
- **3 lives:** you lose one each time the ball falls past the paddle. When they run out you get a "Game Over" screen, and clearing level 2 shows "You Win". Either way, Space or a click starts a new game.
- **Keyboard:** ←/→ or A/D move the paddle, Space or Enter launches the ball, and P or Esc pauses.
- **Mouse:** the paddle follows the mouse, and a click launches the ball.

The game also pauses on its own if you switch to another window or tab.
